verify_detail: rk around with a longer wait — it\'s effectively a coin flip baked into app cold-start, landing "unready" (button hidden) roughly 25–40% of the time. That\'s a genuine app-side bug, not a test problem: the UI test\'s "assert visible" step needs either a fix in the app (make the buffer init deterministic/eagerly-ready before Diagnostics is reachable) or, if unfixable short-term, the test should assert on whichever of the two valid states appears rather than assuming the button is always present.'
